ocr_samples: 陸太をもっとよくみてみたい?
わ...私なんで道端でこんな格好してるんだろ?
恥ずかしくて心臓が飛び出しそうで
頭がくらくらするかも
translations: Do I really want to take a closer look at Lu Tai?
W... Why am I dressed up like this by the roadside?
It’s so embarrassing that my heart feels like it’s about to burst out.
My head might also start spinning.
